name: tern-todo
summary: Publish an interactive Glitch plan identity for the native Tern TODO view, without prompting or changing an agent's input.
way_in: When /glitch-plan (Codex: $glitch-plan) creates a canonical plan OR /glitch-execute deliberately starts/resumes it, read README.md and CONTRACT.md before implementation. Adopt the explicit agreed checkpoint block if missing, identify the durable agent PID, and publish. entry_hook.py delivers this instruction at workflow entry; descriptor presence alone does not invoke it. Clear only your own binding on fresh startup/reset/end. Interactive only.
